---
title: "long-term-spectral-average"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
```

## Forest Habitat SPLs

### Battery Island

```{r}
library(here)
battery_island_spl <- read.csv("/users/aminashenasa/soundscapes_data/data/acoustic_data/spl_data/Battery_Island/HydroMoth_0/spl.csv")
```

```{r}

# 2. Combine the separate 'Date' and 'Time' columns into one Timestamp column
# Note: Check if your columns are capitalized exactly like 'Date' and 'Time'
battery_island_spl <- battery_island_spl %>%
  mutate(Timestamp = as.POSIXct(paste(Date, Time), format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz="UTC"))

# 3. Filter for your exact 5-day window
start_datetime <- ymd_hms("2025-07-23 23:59:43", tz = "UTC")
end_datetime   <- ymd_hms("2025-07-28 23:59:32", tz = "UTC")

filtered_battery_island_spl <- battery_island_spl %>%
  filter(Timestamp >= start_datetime & Timestamp <= end_datetime)

# 4. Reshape data from wide columns to long format rows
long_data <- filtered_battery_island_spl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = contains("Octave"), # Dynamically grabs all your "1/3 Octave Band" columns
    names_to = "Frequency_Raw",
    values_to = "dB"
  )

# 5. Clean up the messy column names and filter out frequencies above 24 kHz
long_data <- long_data %>%
  # Extract just the raw numeric Hz value by stripping 'X' and everything after 'Hz'
  mutate(Freq_Hz = as.numeric(gsub("Hz.*", "", gsub("^X", "", Frequency_Raw)))) %>%
  
  # REMOVE EMPTY BANDS: Filter out anything higher than your 24 kHz Nyquist limit
  filter(Freq_Hz <= 24000) %>%
  
  # Create a clean label format (e.g., converts 16000 Hz to "16.0 kHz")
  mutate(Frequency_Clean = ifelse(Freq_Hz >= 1000, 
                                  paste0(round(Freq_Hz/1000, 1), " kHz"), 
                                  paste0(round(Freq_Hz, 0), " Hz")))

# 6. Sort the frequencies numerically so they stack correctly from lowest to highest
long_data <- long_data %>%
  arrange(Freq_Hz) %>%
  mutate(Frequency_Clean = factor(Frequency_Clean, levels = unique(Frequency_Clean)))


## 7. Convert the Timestamp from UTC to Alaska Time
long_data <- long_data %>%
  mutate(Timestamp = with_tz(Timestamp, tzone = "America/Anchorage"))

# Verify immediately after this line:
attr(long_data$Timestamp, "tzone")  # should now print "America/Anchorage"

# 8. Adjust your filter window to use Alaska Time if needed 
# (Or keep it as is if you want to slice the exact same data chunk)
start_datetime_akdt <- with_tz(start_datetime, tzone = "America/Anchorage")
end_datetime_akdt   <- with_tz(end_datetime, tzone = "America/Anchorage")

# Calculate the actual sampling interval, forced to seconds
time_diffs <- diff(sort(unique(long_data$Timestamp)))
units(time_diffs) <- "secs"
time_res <- as.numeric(names(sort(table(time_diffs), decreasing = TRUE)[1]))

# 9.. Create the polished plot with custom X-axis time breaks
# Build breaks anchored to 9am and 9pm each day, based on your actual AKDT range
akdt <- "America/Anchorage"
first_day <- as.Date(min(long_data$Timestamp), tz = akdt)   # 2025-07-23
last_day  <- as.Date(max(long_data$Timestamp), tz = akdt)   # 2025-07-28

break_seq <- seq(
  from = as.POSIXct(paste(first_day, "09:00:00"),    tz = akdt),
  to   = as.POSIXct(paste(last_day + 1, "09:00:00"), tz = akdt),
  by   = "12 hours"
)

battery_island_spectrogram_plot <- ggplot(long_data, aes(x = Timestamp, y = Frequency_Clean, fill = dB)) +
  geom_tile(width = time_res, height = 1, color = NA, linewidth = 0) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "dB Level", na.value = "grey20") +
  scale_x_datetime(
    breaks = break_seq,
    date_labels = "%b-%d %I:%M %p",   # e.g. "Jul-24 09:00 AM"
    limits = c(start_datetime_akdt, end_datetime_akdt),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.03))
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "5-Day Long Term Spectral Average (LTSA)",
    x = "Date & Time (Alaska Daylight Time - AKDT)",
    y = "Frequency Band"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Render the plot
print(battery_island_spectrogram_plot)
```

```{r}
time_res <- as.numeric(names(sort(table(time_diffs), decreasing = TRUE)[1]))

# 9.. Create the polished plot with custom X-axis time breaks
# Build breaks anchored to 9am and 9pm each day, based on your actual AKDT range
akdt <- "America/Anchorage"
first_day <- as.Date(min(long_data$Timestamp), tz = akdt)   # 2025-07-23
last_day  <- as.Date(max(long_data$Timestamp), tz = akdt)   # 2025-07-28

break_seq <- seq(
  from = as.POSIXct(paste(first_day, "09:00:00"),    tz = akdt),
  to   = as.POSIXct(paste(last_day + 1, "09:00:00"), tz = akdt),
  by   = "12 hours"
)

sandy_cove_spectrogram_plot <- ggplot(long_data, aes(x = Timestamp, y = Frequency_Clean, fill = dB)) +
  geom_tile(width = time_res, height = 1, color = NA, linewidth = 0) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "dB Level", na.value = "grey20") +
  scale_x_datetime(
    breaks = break_seq,
    date_labels = "%b-%d %I:%M %p",   # e.g. "Jul-24 09:00 AM"
    limits = c(start_datetime_akdt, end_datetime_akdt),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.03))
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "5-Day Long Term Spectral Average (LTSA)",
    x = "Date & Time (Alaska Daylight Time - AKDT)",
    y = "Frequency Band"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

#render the plot
print(sandy_cove_spectrogram_plot)
range(long_data$Timestamp)
```

## Combining plots

```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(scales) 
#shared color scale

shared_scale <- scale_fill_viridis_c(
  option = "magma",
  limits = c(-80, -20),
  oob    = scales::squish,
  name   = "dB Level"
)
#shared y-axis
thin_y_axis <- scale_y_discrete(
  breaks = c("20 Hz", "50 Hz", "125 Hz", "315 Hz", "794 Hz",
             "2 kHz", "5 kHz", "12.7 kHz", "20.2 kHz")
)

#per-plot cleanup
clean_plot <- function(p, site_name) {
  p +
    shared_scale +
    thin_y_axis +
    ggtitle(site_name) +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 7)
    )
}

# Strips x-axis text, ticks, and title -- used on the top 2 plots
# in each column so only the bottom plot shows the x-axis
drop_x_axis <- theme(
  axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
)

sandy_cove_spectrogram_plot     <- clean_plot(sandy_cove_spectrogram_plot, "Sandy Cove") + drop_x_axis
samsing_cove_spectrogram_plot   <- clean_plot(samsing_cove_spectrogram_plot, "Samsing Cove") + drop_x_axis
harris_island_spectrogram_plot  <- clean_plot(harris_island_spectrogram_plot, "Harris Island")  # bottom of left column, keeps x-axis

middle_island_spectrogram_plot  <- clean_plot(middle_island_spectrogram_plot, "Middle Island") + drop_x_axis
battery_island_spectrogram_plot <- clean_plot(battery_island_spectrogram_plot, "Battery Island") + drop_x_axis
crow_island_spectrogram_plot    <- clean_plot(crow_island_spectrogram_plot, "Crow Island")  # bottom of right column, keeps x-axis

#assemble columns
urchin_barrens <- sandy_cove_spectrogram_plot /
                   samsing_cove_spectrogram_plot /
                   harris_island_spectrogram_plot

kelp_forests <- middle_island_spectrogram_plot /
                 battery_island_spectrogram_plot /
                 crow_island_spectrogram_plot

#column headers
header_style <- grid::gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold")

urchin_header <- patchwork::wrap_elements(
  grid::textGrob("Urchin Barren", gp = header_style, vjust = 0.5)
) + theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

kelp_header <- patchwork::wrap_elements(
  grid::textGrob("Kelp Forest", gp = header_style, vjust = 0.5)
) + theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

header_row <- urchin_header | kelp_header

#combine plots
combined_plot <- (header_row / (urchin_barrens | kelp_forests)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", heights = c(.05, 1)) +   # shrink header row
  plot_annotation(
    title = "5-Day Long Term Spectral Averages by Site",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, margin = margin(b = 2)))
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
  plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 15, b = 5, l = 5)
  )

combined_plot

ggsave("combined_spectrograms.png", combined_plot, width = 14, height = 12, dpi = 400)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Returns a single flat 5-panel stack: spectrogram + NDSI + ACI + ADI + AEI
build_site_stack <- function(spectrogram_plot, data, site_name, start_local, end_local, break_seq) {
  
  site_data <- data %>%
    filter(SITE == site_name) %>%
    filter(Timestamp >= start_local & Timestamp <= end_local)
  
  make_index_panel <- function(index_name, show_x_axis = FALSE) {
    p <- ggplot(site_data, aes(x = Timestamp, y = .data[[index_name]])) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.4, color = "steelblue") +
      scale_x_datetime(
        breaks = break_seq,
        date_labels = "%b-%d %I:%M %p",
        limits = c(start_local, end_local),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.03))
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(y = index_name, x = NULL) +
      theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )
    
    if (show_x_axis) {
      p <- p + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 7))
    } else {
      p <- p + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
    }
    p
  }
  
  spec_top <- spectrogram_plot + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
  ndsi_panel <- make_index_panel("NDSI")
  aci_panel  <- make_index_panel("ACI")
  adi_panel  <- make_index_panel("ADI")
  aei_panel  <- make_index_panel("AEI", show_x_axis = TRUE)
  
  # FLAT stack - no nested patchwork objects
  spec_top / ndsi_panel / aci_panel / adi_panel / aei_panel +
    plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1, 1, 1, 1.3)) +
    plot_annotation(title = site_name, theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)))
}

# Build all six as flat stacks directly
sandy_cove_paired     <- build_site_stack(sandy_cove_spectrogram_plot,     all_data, "Sandy_Cove",     start_local, end_local, break_seq)
samsing_cove_paired   <- build_site_stack(samsing_cove_spectrogram_plot,   all_data, "Samsing_Cove",   start_local, end_local, break_seq)
harris_island_paired  <- build_site_stack(harris_island_spectrogram_plot,  all_data, "Harris_Island",  start_local, end_local, break_seq)
middle_island_paired  <- build_site_stack(middle_island_spectrogram_plot,  all_data, "Middle_Island",  start_local, end_local, break_seq)
battery_island_paired <- build_site_stack(battery_island_spectrogram_plot, all_data, "Battery_Island", start_local, end_local, break_seq)
crow_island_paired    <- build_site_stack(crow_island_spectrogram_plot,   all_data, "Crow_Island",    start_local, end_local, break_seq)
```

```{r}
build_site_stack <- function(spectrogram_plot, data, site_name,
                             start_local, end_local, break_seq,
                             sun_times = NULL) {

  site_data <- data %>%
    filter(SITE == site_name,
           full_datetime >= start_local,
           full_datetime <= end_local)

  
  # sunrise/sunset lines (long format: event + time)
  add_sun_lines <- function(p) {
    if (is.null(sun_win) || nrow(sun_win) == 0) return(p)
    p +
      geom_vline(data = filter(sun_win, event == "sunrise"),
                 aes(xintercept = time),
                 color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_vline(data = filter(sun_win, event == "sunset"),
                 aes(xintercept = time),
                 linetype = "longdash", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5)
  }
  
  # sun events inside the window, filtered per-event 
  sun_win <- NULL
  if (!is.null(sun_times)) {
    sun_win <- bind_rows(
      tibble(event = "sunrise", time = sun_times$sunrise),
      tibble(event = "sunset",  time = sun_times$sunset)
    ) %>%
      filter(time >= start_local, time <= end_local) %>%
      arrange(time)
  }

  # night intervals: sunset(day n) -> sunrise(day n+1) 
  # built from the FULL table so edge nights aren't lost, then trimmed
  night_win <- NULL
  if (!is.null(sun_times) && nrow(sun_times) > 1) {
    st <- sun_times %>% arrange(sunrise)
    night_win <- tibble(
      start = head(st$sunset, -1),
      end   = tail(st$sunrise, -1)
    ) %>%
      filter(start < end_local, end > start_local)
  }

  # night shading
  add_night_shade <- function(p) {
    if (is.null(night_win) || nrow(night_win) == 0) return(p)
    p + geom_rect(data = night_win, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                  aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
                  fill = "grey20", alpha = 0.10)
  }

  make_index_panel <- function(index_name, show_x_axis = FALSE,
                               colour = "steelblue", limits = NULL,
                               y_label = index_name) {

    p <- ggplot(site_data, aes(x = full_datetime, y = .data[[index_name]]))

    p <- add_night_shade(p)                              # 1. shading underneath
    p <- p + geom_line(linewidth = 0.4, color = colour)  # 2. data on top
    p <- add_sun_lines(p)                                # 3. lines on top of that

    p <- p +
      scale_x_datetime(
        breaks = break_seq,
        date_labels = "%b-%d %I:%M %p",
        limits = c(start_local, end_local),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.03)),
        timezone = site_tz
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(y = y_label, x = NULL) +
      theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )

    if (!is.null(limits)) p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = limits)

    if (show_x_axis) {
      p <- p + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 7))
    } else {
      p <- p + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
    }
    p
  }

  # spectrogram: lines only
  spec_top <- spectrogram_plot + labs(title = NULL, subtitle = NULL)
  spec_top <- add_sun_lines(spec_top) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

  ndsi_panel <- make_index_panel("NDSI")
  aci_panel  <- make_index_panel("ACI")
  adi_panel  <- make_index_panel("ADI")
  aei_panel  <- make_index_panel("AEI")

  barren_panel <- make_index_panel(
    "prob_barren", colour = "firebrick", limits = c(0, 1),
    y_label = "Probability of\nUrchin Barren (SVM)"
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50")

  urchin_panel <- make_index_panel(
    "urchin_pc1", show_x_axis = TRUE, colour = "darkgreen",
    limits = c(-4.5, 2), y_label = "Urchin Noise (PC1)"
  )

  clean_name <- gsub("_", " ", site_name)

  (spec_top / ndsi_panel / aci_panel / adi_panel /
     aei_panel / barren_panel / urchin_panel) +
    plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1.3)) +
    plot_annotation(title = clean_name,
                    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)))
}
```
